documents.text: PYTHON_MARKER Python handles document processing and application logic in Docu AI.
CHROMA_MARKER ChromaDB stores vector embeddings for semantic retrieval.
OLLAMA_MARKER Ollama runs the local language model used to generate answers.
STREAMLIT_MARKER Streamlit provides the interface for uploading PDFs and asking questions.
SOURCE_MARKER Retrieved chunks retain source names and page numbers for traceability.
